title: Pollen pack checkout moves to Stripe
summary:
Stripe checkout was added for Pollen packs, while image defaults, Claude fallbacks, and high-volume API-key verification got fixes.

Added Stripe checkout for $5, $10, $20, and $50 Pollen packs, with promotion codes, automatic tax, and optional business VAT details. The beta multiplier doubles credits calculated from the discounted, pre-tax payment amount.

Image requests that omit `model` now use the default instead of returning 400. Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5 fallback configurations now supply a default `max_tokens` value when the caller has not set one.

Raised the API-key verification limit from 5 to 10,000 requests per second to prevent concurrent requests, including game traffic, from receiving erroneous 401 responses.
